chosen_titles.rationale: Title 42 (Public Officers and Agencies) contains Ch. 42.17 'Disclosure -- Campaign finances -- Lobbying' — WA's lobbying-disclosure regime at the 2010 vintage.

notes: WA 2010 on Justia is hosted ONLY as volume-level monolith pages (e.g., /codes/washington/2010/volume-5-titles-35a-through-42/) which expose nothing but a single PDF download link — no browsable title/chapter/section URLs exist at 2010. Probed candidates that all 404'd: /codes/washington/2010/title-42/, /title42/, /Title42/, /42/, /42.17/, /title-42/chapter-42.17/, /title-42/42-17/, and the section-level /title-42/42-17/42-17-150/. The 2010 state-index TSV (saved here) lists only 'Titles 1 through 8', 'Volume 2 ... Volume 10' entries; pass-1 has no actionable URL to pick. Substituted to 2009 (1 year off, within the ±5 window) because both 2009 and 2011 are browsable. 2009 was preferred over 2011 because (a) RCW 42.17 was the chapter operatively in force during calendar 2010 — the 2010 c 204 reorganization that created RCW 42.17A had a January 1, 2012 effective date — and 2009 Justia hosts the full RCW 42.17 chapter (110 leaves), while 2011 hosts the post-reorg structure with 42.17 partly recodified into 42.17A; (b) 2009 anchor text explicitly labels Ch. 42.17 'Disclosure -- Campaign finances -- Lobbying' confirming lobbying is in-chapter. 2009 Justia also exposes Ch. 42.17A as a parallel chapter with the consolidation pre-staged for the 2012 effective date — that chapter is OUT of scope for vintage 2010 (not yet operative).
